cases_evaluated.name: Hermes type leaks into Core
cases_evaluated.condition: Core execution models import or reference Hermes-private classes

cases_evaluated.name: Hermes profile becomes canonical role
cases_evaluated.condition: Hermes profile name is used as canonical role name

cases_evaluated.name: Core imports Hermes runtime directly
cases_evaluated.condition: Core execution dispatcher directly imports hermes_host or daemon

cases_evaluated.name: CLI calls Hermes directly
cases_evaluated.condition: CLI command bypasses Unified Ingress and calls Hermes daemon directly

cases_evaluated.name: CLI becomes exclusive execution entrypoint
cases_evaluated.condition: Core execution API is accessible only via CLI binary

cases_evaluated.name: Heuristic best executor selection
cases_evaluated.condition: Core ranks or auto-selects executor without explicit request

cases_evaluated.name: Silent Hermes fallback
cases_evaluated.condition: Missing or incompatible executor silently falls back to Hermes

cases_evaluated.name: Silent capability downgrade
cases_evaluated.condition: Unsupported requirement is silently ignored rather than failing closed

cases_evaluated.name: Arbitrary executor command string
cases_evaluated.condition: CLI accepts arbitrary unvalidated shell/executor command string

cases_evaluated.name: Arbitrary shell/terminal access
cases_evaluated.condition: Adapter exposes generic unconstrained bash terminal tool

cases_evaluated.name: Generic Git write API
cases_evaluated.condition: Adapter exposes generic arbitrary git commit/push API

cases_evaluated.name: Generic GitHub API
cases_evaluated.condition: Adapter exposes raw generic GitHub REST/GraphQL write endpoint

cases_evaluated.name: Adapter makes semantic role decision
cases_evaluated.condition: Adapter changes or invents semantic role

cases_evaluated.name: Adapter changes task intent
cases_evaluated.condition: Adapter rewrites semantic instruction or parameters

cases_evaluated.name: Adapter auto semantic retry
cases_evaluated.condition: Adapter retries failed task under altered semantics without authorization

cases_evaluated.name: Executor-local task ID used as canonical identity
cases_evaluated.condition: Executor host task ID replaces canonical_task_id

cases_evaluated.name: Malformed package dispatched
cases_evaluated.condition: Invalid package bypassed schema validation and dispatched

cases_evaluated.name: Unknown executor state mapped to completed

cases_evaluated.name: Arbitrary Hermes object appears in CanonicalResult
cases_evaluated.condition: Hermes-private object escaped into CanonicalResult payload

cases_evaluated.name: Reference adapter becomes production default
cases_evaluated.condition: Test double reference adapter used in production execution

cases_evaluated.name: Live Hermes dispatch during planning/tests where not authorized
cases_evaluated.condition: Live host daemon spawned during offline unit tests

cases_evaluated.name: Deployment/runtime activation pulled into planning
cases_evaluated.condition: Planning phase performs live deployment

cases_evaluated.name: M4 mutation semantics redefined
cases_evaluated.condition: plan_init or plan_retirement contracts altered
